item.title: Chic Oak Cat Tree with Sherpa Cushions | Modern Pet Decor
item.description: Upgrade your home with this stunning natural oak cat tree featuring cozy white sherpa cushions—the ultimate must-have for style-conscious pet parents! 🐾 Care Tip 1: Place near a window for natural sunlight and bird-watching enrichment. Care Tip 2: Spot clean the removable cushions weekly with pet-safe detergent to keep your furry friend's lounge area fresh and inviting. #PetProducts #DogMomMustHaves #CatFurniture #CozyPetHome #PetCareTips
